---
name: Propose an experiment or open dataset
about: A numerical question with a measurable outcome and bounded inputs
title: "Experiment proposal: "
---

## Question and decision

What observation would change the current conclusion? Distinguish a new result from a rerun or correction.

## Open waveform source or model

Provide primary links, version, access terms, sampling rate, units and electrode/reference details. Explain relevance to around-ear EEG. Leave unavailable details explicitly unknown. Do not attach private recordings or identifying information.

## Frozen comparison

Specify discovery inputs, data splits, model families, settings/seeds, common observation denominator, null controls and success/failure criteria before fitting. For an LLM panel, separate prompt/model priors from numerical signal evidence.

## Resources and publication

Estimate download, compute, storage and any API cost. Describe the data/model/code artifacts and checks needed for a numbered Research Note.
